description: Android activity class for managing key chain installation, SSL server control, and certificate display in a demo app.

classes.name: KeyChainDemoActivity
classes.description: Main activity for demo app managing key chain, SSL server, and certificate info.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and sets up button click handlers.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intent to stop SSL server if requested.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Callback when user selects a key alias; saves and displays info.

methods.name: getAlias
methods.description: Retrieves stored key alias from preferences.

methods.name: setAlias
methods.description: Stores selected key alias in preferences.

methods.name: printInfo
methods.description: Displays certificate chain and private key info in UI.

methods.name: installPkcs12
methods.description: Reads PKCS12 file from assets and initiates installation intent.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of key chain installation activity.

methods.name: chooseCert
methods.description: Launches dialog for user to select a private key alias.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves certificate chain for given alias.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves private key for given alias.

methods.name: isKeyChainAccessible
methods.description: Checks if key chain certificates and keys are available.

methods.name: disableKeyChainButton
methods.description: Disables and updates key chain install button after installation.
